func ScrollAreaExample() *native.Node {
	return ui.ScrollArea.Root(
		ui.ScrollAreaRootProps{
			ViewportSize: func() ui.Extent { return ui.Extent{Width: 320, Height: 160} },
			ContentSize:  func() ui.Extent { return ui.Extent{Width: 320, Height: 880} },
		},
		func() *native.Node {
			var children []*native.Node
			state := ui.UseScrollAreaState()
			children = append(children, ui.ScrollArea.Viewport(
				ui.PartProps{Style: ui.Style().
					Width(320).
					Height(160).
					Overflow("hidden")},
				func() *native.Node {
					return ui.ScrollArea.Content(
						ui.PartProps{Style: func() ui.StyleBuilder {
							return ui.Style().Transform(fmt.Sprintf("translateY(%gpx)", -state().Offset.Y))
						}},
						func() *native.Node {
							var children []*native.Node
							for index := range 40 {
								children = append(children, ui.Text("Row ", index).Height(22).Node)
							}
							return ui.Fragment(children)
						},
					)
				},
			))
			children = append(children, ui.ScrollArea.Scrollbar(
				ui.ScrollAreaScrollbarProps{Orientation: "vertical"},
				func() *native.Node { return ui.ScrollArea.Thumb(ui.ScrollAreaThumbProps{Orientation: "vertical"}) },
			))
			return ui.Fragment(children)
		},
	)
}

func ToastExample() *native.Node {
	return ui.Toast.Provider(
		ui.ToastProviderProps{Timeout: 5000, Limit: 3},
		func() *native.Node {
			var children []*native.Node
			manager := ui.UseToastManager()
			children = append(children, ui.Button(
				"Save",
			).OnClick(func() { manager.Add(ui.ToastRequest{Title: "Saved", Type: "success"}) }).Node)
			children = append(children, ui.Toast.Viewport(
				ui.ToastViewportProps{},
				func() *native.Node {
					return ui.For(
						manager.Toasts,
						func(toast ui.ToastDeclaration, _ func() int) *native.Node {
							return ui.Toast.Root(
								ui.ToastPartProps{ToastID: toast.ID},
								func() *native.Node {
									return ui.Fragment([]*native.Node{ui.Toast.Title(
										ui.ToastPartProps{ToastID: toast.ID},
										toast.Title,
									),
										ui.Toast.Close(ui.ToastPartProps{ToastID: toast.ID}, "Dismiss")})
								},
							)
						},
						func(toast ui.ToastDeclaration) any { return toast.ID },
						nil,
					)
				},
			))
			return ui.Fragment(children)
		},
	)
}

func RadioGroupExample() *native.Node {

	return ui.RadioGroup.Root(
		ui.RadioGroupProps{
			Value:         func() *string { current := value(); return &current },
			OnValueChange: func(next string, _ *native.Event) { setValue(next) },
		},
		func() *native.Node {
			var children []*native.Node
			for _, option := range []string{"light", "dark", "system"} {
				children = append(children, ui.Radio.Root(

					func() *native.Node {
						return ui.Fragment([]*native.Node{ui.Radio.Indicator(ui.PartProps{}), ui.Text(option).Node})
					},
				))
			}
			return ui.Fragment(children)
		},
	)
}
